mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand and construction activity, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy stance that reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and elevated federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) indicates a deteriorating labor market under monetary tightening, which typically triggers a sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market stress
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE rising and FEDFUNDS above 2.0% fails to predict negative returns, with SPX 20-day returns positive in more than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity and potential economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, INDPRO declines do not correlate with negative SPX 60-day returns, as evidenced by a Rank IC below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates persistent inflation, which typically leads to higher interest rates and reduced equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL is rising (month-over-month).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage pressures and potential central bank tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening demand and supply conditions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO fails to predict negative returns, with SPX 5-day returns positive in more than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle recoveries, a surge in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer spending, which typically precedes improved corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In early-cycle recovery periods, RSAFS surges do not correlate with positive SPX 60-day returns, as evidenced by a Rank IC below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
